text:
elaine: FYI the stateful default-deny firewall rollout hit eu-west keystore export yesterday and triggered a big audit reindex + KMS grant churn. seeing warm-pool joins fail.

ops-bot: [ALERT] keystore-exporter-euw 504 x73 in 20m; privatelink conntrack_near_full; warm-pool-join-fail=24.

hiro: paste from node-14: 
```
Mar 24 05:11:22 kubelet: warmup pod failed: keystore-exporter timeout
kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
keystore-exporter euw org=infra status=504 latency=980ms
```

ben: Looks like two simultaneous things: (1) firewall state rollback produced extra auth hits as services re-auth, (2) KMS rotation caused re-grants and retries, spiking exporter QPS. Both pressure privatelink NAT.

elaine: short options: bump conntrack, throttle exporter, or pause non-critical audit exports temporarily. Security will need to approve retention/rollback.

security-bot: [NOTIFICATION] firewall-change: stateful-default-deny applied to euw-subnet-privatelink at 02:00Z. Change id CHG-8273.

hiro: quick diag: conntrack_count=195420 nf_conntrack_max=200000 -> table nearing full. Exporter 95th latency spiking.

ben: cost/ops note: if we pause reindex + reduce retention temporarily we save ~6-8k/mo in egress and reduce bursts. but security compliance asked for longer retention and stricter flow logs.

elaine: I'll open a scoped compliance exception to pause non-critical audit streams and request Security sign-off for canary rollback of exporter-facing index to 45d. will include cost delta.

hiro: infra mitigation I'll run now: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=300000` on edge NATs and enable conntrack hashsize bump. monitoring.

ops-bot: [INFO] conntrack_max update pushed to nat-euw fleet. starting metrics stream.

ben: parallel step: can we apply a token-bucket throttle at the exporter ingress? throttling to 250rps with burst 500 should smooth it. i'll push a canary config to 2/10 replicas.

elaine: please do. pinging @security for a fast approval on retention canary. record: region fallback plan is to route new GPU allocations to eu-north for 24h if warm-pools don't stabilize.

security-bot: [REQ] approval required for retention rollback. attach justification and re-audit plan to ticket #COMPL-4022.

hiro: 6m update: conntrack_count peaked at 212k then stabilized after bump. exporter 504s reduced ~60%. warm-pool join rate improved 28% -> 80%.

ben: throttle canary deployed to 20% replicas: exporter errors steady but latency within tolerance.

elaine: good. i'll document cost tradeoffs and postmortem template in the ticket. if Security approves we keep canary for 2h then vote on 90d vs 180d.

ops-bot: [RESOLVE] alert suppressed. follow-up tasks: PLAT-9101 exporter-batching, PLAT-9102 async-export-queue, COMPL-4022 retention-canary.

hiro: next steps from infra: schedule exporter batching PoC (2w), add exporter rate limiter defaults, and tune NAT conntrack persistence.

ben: schedule a short ops-runbook: firewall rollbacks should include a dry-run for keystore exporters and a pre-bump conntrack checklist.

elaine: agreed. closing thread unless new regressions. will update ticket with cost numbers and security thread link.
